calculation_type: GGA/GGA+U relaxation, Materials Project standard workflow (https://docs.materialsproject.org/methodology/materials-methodology) -- semilocal functional; known to underestimate band gaps, which is why the metallicity oracle restricts to a clearly-gapped/clearly-gapless decision with an explicit abstention band rather than a single threshold.
note: These are standardized computational references (Materials Project's own DFT calculations), not experimental ground truth. Own-DFT validation is reserved for missing or clearly questionable cases, per the domain co-author's review, not run over this full sample.
